was: BLM Arizona Strip campground in the Virgin River Gorge along I-15 (Cedar Pocket Exit, MP 18), ~20 mi SW of St. George UT. ~77 sites; no hookups, flush toilets, drinking water, no dump. Big pull-throughs handle large rigs; open year-round; ~25 best sites reservable online, remainder FCFS, 14-day limit. --Claude

was: NPS-run campground at Navajo National Monument, ~9 mi off US-160 near Shonto/Kayenta. Sunset View loop: 31 sites, paved roads and pads, RVs/rigs up to 28 ft, several pull-through/double sites, no hookups or dump. Flush toilets year-round; potable water (seasonal). First-come first-served, open year-round; 7-day limit. Companion Canyon View loop caps under 28 ft (skip for big rigs). --Claude

Showers, potable water, dump station, paved boat launch. Odd-numbered sites reservable online, even-numbered FCFS. Seasonally closed ~June 1 to October (summer heat). --Claude

No permit; open flat desert with no designated sites, no water/toilets/hookups; accommodates tents through large RVs, drive-in on maintained dirt (some entrances have dips). Large campground; Mesquite Loop 40 sites reservable Nov 1-Apr 30 (odd sites) / FCFS (even), more sites in the area; no site hookups, potable water, ramadas, paved pull-throughs, trailers to 32 ft, paved boat ramp. Note Roosevelt Lake drawdown — current waterline can sit well below the loops. --Claude

was: Apache-Sitgreaves NF (Black Mesa RD), Mogollon Rim near Woods Canyon Lake. Large campground (~136 sites in four loops of meadow/pine), vault toilets, potable water, no hookups; trailers/RVs to ~32 ft. 121 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 27 first-come-first-served. Electric-motor-only lake. Seasonal. --Claude

Brundrett 1 loop has 12 individual sites accommodating RVs/trailers to ~45 ft; also a group area (Brundrett 2) and equestrian group site (both reservable on recreation.gov).
